general_news.title: Pentair stock completes USD 1.4 billion Taco acquisition
general_news.summary: Pentair plc has finalized its $1.4 billion acquisition of Taco Group Holdings, integrating Taco into its Water Solutions segment to expand into hydronic and water-based solutions. This acquisition comes as Pentair faces a 17% drop in second-quarter revenue, primarily due to weak pool demand. Analysts currently maintain a "Hold" consensus on Pentair stock, with an average price target of $87.19.
